scope: Design requirements only; no new method identity or executed scenario

scenarios.name: Canonical normal transcript
scenarios.required: A frozen CM2 746-record supplied fixture may be protocol-consistent; do not infer the actual normal 1,000-record population or runtime success.

scenarios.name: Complete collection before projection
scenarios.required: Omitted/duplicate/reordered successor row, changed module pin/flag or false completeness refuses even if both predecessor projections match.

scenarios.name: Operation and raw-byte substitution
scenarios.required: Different event operation, descriptor byte length/hash, count-equivalent collection or table substitution refuses.

scenarios.name: Canonical syntax and exact types
scenarios.required: Duplicate/unknown keys, bool ordinals/counts, floats/NaN, non-ASCII/noncanonical escapes, CR, missing LF and trailing data refuse.

scenarios.name: Ordered primary lifecycle
scenarios.required: Missing/repeated/out-of-order start, wrong owner, PASS without start, duplicate primary or END without outcome refuses.

scenarios.name: Flat subcase conservation
scenarios.required: Require next per-case sub ordinal and exact CASE_END subcount; SUBFAIL sets negative without synthesizing a parent failure.

scenarios.name: Failfast
scenarios.required: After a negative no new start/subcase; an existing case may finish permitted cleanup callbacks and END.

scenarios.name: Skip then mixed cleanup
scenarios.required: SKIP followed by repeated FAIL/ERROR trace groups is retained as negative; a second special primary refuses.

scenarios.name: Expected outcomes
scenarios.required: XFAIL needs complete exception group; XPASS is NONE/zero; late FAIL/ERROR after either refuses under the frozen CM2 subset.

scenarios.name: Fixture ownership and repeated cleanup
scenarios.required: Distinct declared slots may share exact owner/phase; repeated slot, arbitrary owner prefix, incorrect affected selection or missing slot refuses.

scenarios.name: Fixture phase and late failure
scenarios.required: Setup after an affected start refuses; premature teardown without prior negative refuses; fixture failure after all PASS/END makes transcript negative.

scenarios.name: Trace ownership and ordinal
scenarios.required: Missing/extra/interleaved TRACE, changed owner/kind, bool location/count, duplicate frame ordinal or unknown code/line refuses.

scenarios.name: Trace limit and unsupported
scenarios.required: 128 declared frames can fit subject to record caps; 129 or UNSUPPORTED refuses. Do not fabricate a completed group for a producer refusal.

scenarios.name: Trace order limit
scenarios.required: Reordered actual frames that remain valid supplied memberships cannot be authenticated by this parser; document missing original traceback witness.

scenarios.name: Prefix and whole digest
scenarios.required: Wrong footer count/hash, altered earlier byte, repeated/trailing footer or missing footer refuses; whole and nonfooter prefix digests remain distinct.

scenarios.name: Record and byte ceiling
scenarios.required: Check 512-byte line, 4,095 nonfooter/4,096 total and 2-MiB ceilings including reserved footer; over-limit or mid-group prefix never yields success.

scenarios.name: Two-MiB hash path
scenarios.required: Exercise bounded event hashing above 1 MiB without calling/widening frozen one-MiB common.digest; checkpoint failure refuses.

scenarios.name: Hidden cleanup and suite closure
scenarios.required: No raw result asserts cleanup_done, duration order or suite closure merely from PASS/END/footer.

scenarios.name: Late refusal indistinguishability
scenarios.required: Identical bytes with producer refusal after footer yield identical observable parser facts; external final latch remains unavailable.

scenarios.name: Tables and aggregate limits
scenarios.required: Sorted exact table schema, unique pairs/slots, exact affected owner sets, 4,096 row ceilings and one-MiB/depth/node limits all apply before views.

scenarios.name: Defensive repeated joins
scenarios.required: Caller-built Facts/cached hash/mutable replacement cannot bypass fresh raw parsing; repeated invocations return immutable supplied facts.

scenarios.name: Frozen target versus current roster
scenarios.required: Additional verifier methods require explicit successor adoption; frozen CM2 parsing must not claim complete collection of the enlarged current source universe.

scenarios.name: No authority escalation
scenarios.required: Native-looking strings, successful counts, supplied lifecycle declarations and exit0 cannot set authenticated/execution_accepted or enable dispatch.

scenarios.name: Poison formatting
scenarios.required: Future real boundary must cover SkipTest.__str__, assertion operand repr/diffs, mock/helper formatting that allocates, raises or reenters; no execution in this design phase.

scenarios.name: Case and suite equivalence
scenarios.required: Future qualification covers setup omission, decorated/body skip, LIFO and multiple cleanup errors, duration, stop finally, nested unwind and failfast.

scenarios.name: Underlying module cleanup failures
scenarios.required: Preserve distinction between all underlying failures and the reference's first emitted exception; do not invent additional callbacks or claim completeness.

scenarios.name: Original negative witnesses
scenarios.required: Later producer refusal, restoration drift or missing lifecycle/source witness blocks acceptance despite all-PASS bytes.

scenarios.name: Raw capture fidelity
scenarios.required: Missing/duplicated/reordered observer chunks, offset/hash mismatch, text normalization or uncertain cross-stream write order cannot establish original complete capture.

scenarios.name: EOF and cancellation
scenarios.required: Quiet output, child exit or footer does not prove EOF/pipe/tool closure; late stderr, capture error or cancellation retains prefix and refused disposition.

scenarios.name: Escaping and envelopes
scenarios.required: Control-byte expansion and nested/tool framing must fit original return slots; small success descriptor does not prove failure fit.

scenarios.name: Complete allocation
scenarios.required: Unnamed join/lifecycle/chunk metadata or temporary/copy file, borrowed closeout slot, omitted failed/unused charge refuses before effects.

scenarios.name: Original clocks and custody
scenarios.required: No new origin/retry/UUID, external precompilation or supplied guard permits runtime; complete owned closure and separate actual review remain obligatory.
